revision_reason: Fuse moving-main deltas after V28: distinguish producer authorization from concrete runtime instance authentication; promote the exact-semantic-merge failure from generic regression noise to a diagnosed stage-invariant contract defect; add mandatory UNKNOWN/factuality and exact harness-surface floors to checkpoint selection; and require mediator-interaction controls when causal J-Space opens.

successor_deltas.finding: Producer authorization is necessary but not sufficient. A registry can prove that a producer identity/version is allowed, yet a caller can still forge a concrete runtime receipt unless the accepted instance is authenticated by an unforgeable issuer boundary.
axis_B_instance_authentication: replay identity/nonce or equivalent monotonic context
acceptable_instance_mechanisms: cryptographically authenticated typed envelope verified against trusted producer identity/policy
equivalently unforgeable local capability/process/IPC boundary where verifier obtains receipt from trusted issuer rather than accepting caller-mintable authority
successor_deltas.promotion_rule: OBSERVED candidate evidence may pass pre-admission only when both authorization and instance authentication pass; neither may mint canonical truth or direct-effect authority.

successor_deltas.finding: EXACT_FORMAL_SEMANTIC_SIGNATURE legitimately collapses equivalent branches to one, then project_state reuses the external/pre-update >=2-branch validator and rejects the derived singleton.
successor_deltas.required_repair: Keep caller-supplied singleton input rejected; permit singleton only through a narrow proof-carrying post-exact-merge path or explicitly supersede exact merge semantics. Add forged-singleton, merge-policy NONE, non-equivalent-branch and evidence-union/dedup negatives; run the full exact reference-labeler suite repository-bound.

successor_deltas.finding: UNKNOWN/anti-fabrication cannot be averaged away by aggregate score. The TARGET_MEASURED pilot failed current abstain_unknown cases, including fabrication of precise facts for a fictional company.
successor_deltas.selection_law: No checkpoint winner if UNKNOWN/factuality retention falls below the preregistered floor, even if aggregate score is higher.

successor_deltas.finding: Exact rendered serialization and compact instruction-surface compliance are functional HCU harness properties, not cosmetic style. Semantic correctness must be scored separately from wire/ABI compliance.
successor_deltas.selection_law: Enforce a minimum harness-interoperability floor for exact JSON/typed payload and requested bounded-form output.

successor_deltas.finding: A large single-site activation effect is insufficient for context-invariant semantic-vector claims because mediator/component interactions can inflate or suppress observed effects.
required_controls: pairwise mediator interaction for leading sites

training_generation_decision.reason: Concrete OBSERVED instances remain forgeable at the current admission boundary, complete nonempty-history producer authority is open, and the deterministic labeler oracle has an unresolved stage-invariant contradiction. Negative pilot observations are evaluation specifications only until provenance/admission gates close.
